text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) commonly causes increased urination, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and genital yeast infections.
snippet_highlighted_words: increased urination, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and genital yeast infections

list.snippet: Increased urination and thirst: Your body removes extra sugar through urine, which makes you pee more often.
Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Extra sugar in the urine helps bacteria grow, causing burning or pain when you pee.
Genital yeast infections: These happen in both men and women due to sugar buildup, leading to itching and discomfort.
Mild dehydration: Losing more fluid can cause dizziness or lightheadedness when you stand up.
Upper respiratory infections: Mild cold-like symptoms can sometimes occur.
Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood, marked by nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and trouble breathing.
Severe genital infections (Fournier's gangrene): A rare, painful, and serious tissue infection in the area between and around the anus and genitals.
Severe dehydration or kidney damage: Extreme fluid loss can harm kidney function.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia): More likely if you take Jardiance with insulin or other diabetes medications.
Serious allergic reactions: Swelling of the face, lips, or throat, and trouble breathing.
